collab.svc_overview_desc: Content is protected by encryption fingerprints, and change history is linked to detect tampering.
collab.svc_smartlink_sub: Directly connects participants to deliver changes instantly
collab.svc_meshcdn_sub: Shares caches to sync without interruptions
collab.svc_trustchain_sub: Records change history as linked blocks to detect tampering
collab.svc_vaultsync_sub: Safely stores in the browser and restores on reopen
collab.svc_offlinebridge_sub: Queues work while offline and sends automatically on recovery
collab.svc_cryptocore_sub: Creates data fingerprints with standard browser crypto
collab.svc_hybridconnect_sub: Uses direct and server-relay connections together as needed
collab.svc_reactionsync_sub: Delivers emoji reactions to all participants instantly
collab.svc_val_offline_mode: Offline mode — will auto-sync on recovery
collab.help_create_tab_desc: In the Create Room tab, enter a nickname and click Create & Start to start a new collaboration room. To invite others, share the Room Code, Join Link, or QR Code.
collab.help_p2p_desc: P2P Direct Connection: Participants' browsers connect directly to each other, providing the fastest experience with no server load. This is the default. May automatically switch to server-relay mode depending on network conditions.
collab.help_stability_desc: In Enhanced Stability mode, additional STUN/TURN relay servers and a PHP backup server are used alongside P2P to improve connection stability. Connections remain stable even in strict firewall or network environments. Chat/DM works normally via P2P channels.
collab.help_chat_desc: In the Chat tab of the info panel, you can use both group chat and 1:1 private messages (DM). Long-press or right-click a message to access Reply, Copy, Reaction, and other options.
collab.help_presence_desc: Press the status button at the top of the info panel to select one of Online / Away / Busy / Do Not Disturb. After a period of inactivity or when switching to another tab, your status automatically changes to Away, and switches back to Online when you become active again.
collab.help_lock_kick_desc: The host can use the Edit Lock button to temporarily prevent all participants from editing. In the participant list, you can press Kick to remove a specific participant. If the host disconnects, another participant automatically takes over the host role.
collab.help_troubleshooting_desc: If your connection drops frequently, try enabling Enhanced Stability mode when creating a new room. On strict-firewall networks (corporate/school), P2P connections may be blocked and will automatically switch to server-relay mode.
collab.help_server_relay_desc: Server-Relay Mode: The last-resort fallback used when all P2P connections fail. May have slight latency, but document synchronization continues.
